title: basf sues apple us allegedly infringing its face authentication patents 2026 09 03
text:
Sept 3 (Reuters) - BASF (BASFn.DE)
, opens new tab

The complaint was ​filed ​in ⁠the U.S. ​District ​Court ⁠in Midland, ⁠Texas.
